the measure of the light-gathering angle of a lens, which sets the limit of detail visible
the staining of a structure in a colour different from that of the dye applied
items.s: Eosinophilic structure: a component that takes up acidic dye strongly and so appears pink, as cytoplasm does. The other options describe Numerical aperture, Basophilic structure, Metachromasia.

items.q: “a bean-shaped organ with an outer cortex and inner medulla that traps debris from the returning fluid” is the definition of
o: Lymph node
Endothelium
Tunica intima
Thymus
items.s: Lymph node is a bean-shaped organ with an outer cortex and inner medulla that traps debris from the returning fluid.

items.q: In this course, Thymus refers to
o: the innermost coat of a vessel, formed by endothelium and its supporting layer
the middle coat of a vessel, made of smooth muscle and elastic lamellae
the pale inner zone of a lymphoid follicle where dividing B cells accumulate
the lymphoid organ of the upper chest in which T cells mature, marked by lobules and corpuscles
items.s: Thymus: the lymphoid organ of the upper chest in which T cells mature, marked by lobules and corpuscles. The other options describe Germinal centre, Tunica intima, Tunica media.

items.q: In this course, Myofibril refers to
o: spindle-shaped cells with a single central nucleus and no striations, found in viscus walls
the repeating contractile unit between two adjacent Z lines of a striated fibre
a long bundle of contractile filaments lying in the cytoplasm of a muscle cell
a long cylindrical multinucleated cell with cross striations and nuclei at the periphery
items.s: Myofibril: a long bundle of contractile filaments lying in the cytoplasm of a muscle cell. The other options describe Sarcomere, Smooth muscle, Skeletal muscle fibre.

items.q: The correct meaning of Neuron is
o: a star-shaped supporting cell that anchors neurons to vessels and helps form the blood-brain barrier
the conducting cell of nervous tissue, made of a body, dendrites and a single axon
a short branched process that carries impulses towards the nerve cell body
the single long process that carries impulses away from the cell body
items.s: Neuron: the conducting cell of nervous tissue, made of a body, dendrites and a single axon. The other options describe Dendrite, Astrocyte, Axon.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Transitional epithelium.
o: a fine finger-like fold of the free surface that enlarges the area for absorption
two or more layers of cells in which only the deepest rests on the basement membrane
a multilayered lining of the urinary passages whose surface elements change shape with distension
a flattened plate that is thin and scale-like in profile
items.s: Transitional epithelium: a multilayered lining of the urinary passages whose surface elements change shape with distension. The other options describe Squamous cell, Microvillus, Stratified epithelium.

items.q: Alveolus may be defined as
o: a columnar element swollen with mucin that discharges its content onto an epithelial surface
the air passage held open by incomplete rings of cartilage and lined by ciliated epithelium
the phagocytic lining of the liver sinusoids
a thin-walled air sac of the lung across which gas exchange takes place
items.s: Alveolus: a thin-walled air sac of the lung across which gas exchange takes place. The other options describe Kupffer cell, Goblet cell, Trachea.

items.q: Three of these relate to Digestive and respiratory tissue. Which one does not?
o: Squamous cell
Villus
Goblet cell
Enteroendocrine cell
items.s: Every other option belongs to Digestive and respiratory tissue. “Squamous cell” belongs to Epithelial tissue, not Digestive and respiratory tissue.

items.q: Kupffer cell may be defined as
o: a finger-like projection of the small intestinal lining that increases absorptive surface
the phagocytic lining of the liver sinusoids
the hexagonal unit of the liver with a central vein and portal tracts at its corners
the air passage held open by incomplete rings of cartilage and lined by ciliated epithelium
items.s: Kupffer cell: the phagocytic lining of the liver sinusoids. The other options describe Hepatic lobule, Villus, Trachea.

items.q: The correct meaning of Lymphocyte is
o: the largest white element in circulating blood, with a kidney-shaped nucleus and grey-blue cytoplasm
a small round element with a dense nucleus and a thin rim of cytoplasm, central to immune responses
a granulocyte with a lobed nucleus and fine pale granules, the commonest white element in blood
a small anucleate disc fragment shed from megakaryocyte cytoplasm that plugs vessel defects
items.s: Lymphocyte: a small round element with a dense nucleus and a thin rim of cytoplasm, central to immune responses. The other options describe Platelet, Monocyte, Neutrophil.

items.q: The correct meaning of Transitional epithelium is
o: a multilayered lining of the urinary passages whose surface elements change shape with distension
a fine finger-like fold of the free surface that enlarges the area for absorption
a single layer whose nuclei lie at different heights so that it looks layered
a single layer of cells, all of which touch the basement membrane
items.s: Transitional epithelium: a multilayered lining of the urinary passages whose surface elements change shape with distension. The other options describe Simple epithelium, Microvillus, Pseudostratified epithelium.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “a long cylindrical multinucleated cell with cross striations and nuclei at the periphery”
o: Skeletal muscle fibre
Cardiac muscle
Sarcomere
Smooth muscle
items.s: Skeletal muscle fibre is a long cylindrical multinucleated cell with cross striations and nuclei at the periphery.

items.q: Melanocyte may be defined as
o: a spherical sac lined by cuboidal cells and filled with stored colloid
the dominant epidermal element that manufactures the tough protein of the skin surface
the pigment-forming element of the epidermal base that transfers granules to neighbouring cells
the holocrine structure of the dermis that empties an oily secretion into a hair follicle
items.s: Melanocyte: the pigment-forming element of the epidermal base that transfers granules to neighbouring cells. The other options describe Keratinocyte, Thyroid follicle, Sebaceous gland.
